caption: The radio spectrum from 3 MHz to 3 GHz, with the HF, VHF, and UHF regions and the Technician-relevant amateur bands marked, from 10 meters to 23 centimeters.
spoken: This figure shows the radio spectrum on a logarithmic scale, marking the HF, VHF, and UHF regions and the amateur bands a Technician can use, from ten meters to twenty-three centimeters.
